context: Tests whether the skill correctly swaps provider-specific surfaces when the user picks Anthropic instead of the more common OpenAI default — executor factory, model selector, and environment variable name all change in lockstep.

checklist.name: Uses simpleAnthropicExecutor
checklist.description: Main.kt's promptExecutor is built with simpleAnthropicExecutor (not simpleOpenAIExecutor or any other provider factory)

checklist.name: Selects a current Anthropic model
checklist.description: llmModel is an AnthropicModels.* entry that exists in 1.0 (e.g., Opus_4_7 or Opus_4_6, NOT the removed Haiku_3 or any other retired Anthropic model entry)

checklist.name: Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment
checklist.description: Reads the Anthropic-specific environment variable (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) from System.getenv, not OPENAI_API_KEY copy-pasted from a template, not a hardcoded literal

checklist.name: Accepts the existing-empty-directory state without overwrite
checklist.description: Treats the existing empty directory as a valid scaffold target — does not refuse, does not delete, does not ask the user to recreate it

checklist.name: Uses 1.0+ umbrella coordinate
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts uses ai.koog:koog-agents at the selected Koog 1.3 stable/beta version

checklist.name: Top-level AIAgent factory call
checklist.description: Main.kt calls AIAgent(...) as a top-level factory function, not a companion-invoke or concrete subtype constructor
